$schema: internal-note://ai-workspace.prompts-manifest — no formal JSON schema; shape is {generatedAt, entries[{id,title,sha256}], doc} and consumers are the prompt-integrity verifier (T-20261112-003) and human governance review; see doc for the update invariant
doc: Expected SHA256 of each authority-bearing automation prompt. Any change to an automation prompt MUST update this manifest in the same governance change set; drift is detected daily at 06:00 KST by the prompt-integrity verifier — the verifier OF RECORD is scripts/verify-prompt-integrity.ts scheduled OUT-OF-PROCESS by the host launchd job ai.workspace.prompt-integrity-verify.plist (DEC-20261120-04), not a ZCode automation; a ZCode automation running the same script daily 06:00 remains the documented fallback. The verifier reads the live automation 'prompt' fields byte-exact via bun:sqlite (never the sqlite3 CLI — its read path is not byte-faithful, measured 2026-11-20) and compares against this manifest. Provenance of the initial v4 hashes: the automation records were read out-of-band from the ZCode session log of the dispatching session on 2026-11-12 (CronList/CronCreate are not callable from a dispatched subagent session).
coverage: v5 ratification wave (2026-11-20, reconciliation per DEC-20261120-04 / design §T-20261120-002): the unified 03:00 batch runner — the LIVE store text is RATIFIED as v5 (byte-copy snapshot; the live edits match meeting-agreed controls: gitleaks --redact + deleted-blob scan, ledger repair rows, freshness semantics in the STEP I header, and the phantom memory/meeting-2026-11-12-unified-batch-runner.md citation dropped per DEC-20261120-02). COVERAGE UPDATE (2026-11-20, runner-hardening PR-5 bookkeeping): the prompt-integrity verifier script IS LANDED — scripts/verify-prompt-integrity.ts v1.0.0 via PR #2122 (merge 17dd5e2a7, CI 4/4 green; first armed run reported `prompt integrity verify: 1/1 match`, exec-closure ok); the remaining enforcement gap is the OPERATOR STEP of installing the host launchd job ai.workspace.prompt-integrity-verify.plist (plist + install notes tracked at docs/governance/automation-prompts/, DEC-20261120-04) — until that install is confirmed, scheduled 06:00 KST detection is not yet running, though the runner's STEP 0 --gate wrapper provides in-process defense-in-depth each 03:00 run. V6 REVISION (2026-11-25, design 2026-11-25-upgrade-runner-machinery-batch-design §4.10, DEC-20261125-01, PR #2177): the repository half (this manifest entry and runner-v6.snapshot.txt) is landed first; the LIVE store text is updated to the same bytes by the PM right after the PR merges — until then the verifier reports unratified-live-edit (live v5, snapshot and manifest v6). runner-v5.snapshot.txt is kept as the prior ratified generation, as runner-v4.snapshot.txt was at the v5 bump. The sha256 above covers the snapshot file named in `snapshot`; the verifier must hash the LIVE prompt and reconcile against it (drift = alert).
